item.title: ‘All bets are off’: Donald Trump warns Hamas against using hostages as human shields; calls for immediate release
item.description: Donald Trump issued a strong warning to Hamas regarding reports of using hostages as human shields, stating that "all bets are off" if confirmed and demanding their immediate release. This comes as Israeli forces intensify operations in Gaza City. Trump also addressed concerns about a recent Israeli strike in Doha, assuring that Qatar would not be targeted again, while Netanyahu expressed gratitude for US support.

item.title: 'We are hunting you': Trump claims US strike on narcoterrorists at sea; shares attack footage
item.description: The US military conducted a second strike on a vessel, allegedly a Venezuelan drug boat, resulting in three deaths in international waters, according to Donald Trump. This action follows a previous strike two weeks prior, escalating tensions between the US and Venezuela, marked by accusations, naval deployments, and heightened military activity in the region.

item.title: UAE: Global Village is back! why this 30 year Dubai phenomenon draws millions every year
item.description: Global Village Season 30 runs from October 15, 2025, to May 10, 2026, marking its 30th anniversary. Visitors can expect over 90 pavilions, 3,500 shopping outlets, 250 dining options, and 40,000+ live shows. With new attractions, fireworks, VIP perks, and cultural celebrations, the milestone edition promises a bigger, more diverse experience for families, tourists, and culture enthusiasts.

item.title: Retired? You may be eligible for the UAE 5-Year Retirement Visa: Eligibility, requirements, and benefits explained
item.description: The UAE’s 5-year renewable retirement visa offers financially stable expatriates aged 55+ a secure, tax-friendly path to long-term residency. Part of the 2025 visa reforms, it complements expanded Golden and Blue Visa categories, aiming to diversify the economy and attract global talent and retirees alike. Dubai adds tailored options, enhancing flexibility within the national residency framework.

item.title: No more paper! Oman residents can now legally use digital copies of their national IDs and driver’s licenses
item.description: The Royal Oman Police now legally recognize certified electronic versions of national ID cards and driver’s licenses across Oman. Accessible via the official website, these digital documents hold the same legal status as physical copies. This change, alongside new flexible expat residence cards and extended validity for Omani IDs, reflects Oman’s ongoing commitment to digital transformation and streamlined public services.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Fight back or die...': Why Elon Musk cannot pull a 'Trump' in the UK; even with Tommy Robinson
item.description: ​This is the backdrop Elon Musk has parachuted into, with the grace of a meme lord and the menace of a billionaire arsonist. He has found Britain’s sorest nerve—immigration—and jabbed it with the same glee he once reserved for short-sellers. Grooming gangs, free speech, Tommy Robinson: Musk has taken Britain’s ugliest domestic quarrels and broadcast them to the world, not because he loves Britain, but because chaos is his native language.
item.dc:creator: Nirmalya Dutta
